text:
Revise the implementation while preserving every accepted requirement, public input/output, product visit, workbook write and cleanup. The current review cannot approve t_submit_search: its selector was replaced by an unobserved constant. Use only the observed nullable searchBoxSelector, and consume it on an explicit conditional path checking that exact reference != null. A separate availability boolean does not establish its non-nullability. Never invent selectors or replace missing observations with strings. Both conditional alternatives must expose matching consumer-facing types and nullability.
The current global transforms also consume complete raw snapshot objects. First process every delivered page/record through deterministic field selection or existing bounded independent extract/each; retain compact facts and exact action references needed by each consumer. Interpret only these compact observations, not raw snapshots or duplicate content. Preserve grouping, ordering, completeness and all facts required by the decision. Global selection/ranking remains global. Do not split reasoning or raise limits.
Use observation_complete for the required search and product observations, explicitly check captureTruncated/manifestTruncated before declaring coverage, and fail on incomplete acquisition. Do not treat truncated HTML as a complete product observation or turn missing data into empty successful results. Retain real per-product navigation and the ten-product maximum, extraction from each actual product observation, the actual workbook-writing operations with their producer outputs, and browser cleanup even on verified failure. No permission, budget, runtime or requirement changes.
